records.text: In an archival TMZ clip, Kanye West described a FaceTime conversation involving Ebro Darden and Candace Owens and said he later asked Darden to have Owens on his show.
records.speaker: Kanye West

appearances.snippet: Okay, so Ebro (Ebro Darden), I FaceTime him, and I'm there with Candace, right? And Ebro (Ebro Darden) starts bringing up his version of facts, right? ... Owens has facts. She's researched. And then Candace just pulls out her Jedi lightsaber and just, you know, chops Ebro (Ebro Darden)'s head off with facts. The Ebro (Ebro Darden) FaceTimes me the next day, and he's talking about the scoop, scoop, poop. ... The next day, and he's talking about the scoop, scoop-a-poop, he wants to talk about music now. I said, yo, you're going to have Candace on your show?

conveyance.original_source: Archival TMZ interview played by Owens

records.text: In Kanye West’s account played in an archival TMZ clip, Ebro Darden declined to put Candace Owens on his show because he considered her mean.
records.speaker: Ebro Darden

appearances.snippet: He's like, no, I'm not. She's mean. So you're going to stifle her voice, Ebro (Ebro Darden)? You're choosing to enslave people's minds.

conveyance.original_source: Ebro Darden as quoted by Kanye West in archival TMZ clip played by Owens
